title: Top Eight Match
next_chapter_hook: Mo Xiansheng's words exploded like thunder in Chen Ji's Mental Sea. The person who had never appeared in his memories actually had such a deep connection with his father—and why had Mo Xiansheng waited until today to reveal this?

text.content: After Ling Yuan left, Chen Ji stood alone outside the Tianqing Sect Council Hall. The chill from the Blue Stone Steps seeped through his soles into his marrow. He closed his eyes and tried to use the Tianji Record to divine the old sect master's future—yet the image was blurred as if seen through a layer of water, nothing clear. This feeling he had not experienced for a long time, as if an invisible hand was pulling the threads of fate from his control. "Noted." Chen Ji muttered, cold light flickering in his eyes then vanishing. A being that could make him foresee failure was by no means ordinary. He turned and walked toward the Martial Arena. There was something more important today—the Top Eight Match. No matter what Ling Yuan's schemes were, he had to get through this first.

The Martial Arena was bustling with noise, the banners on the Top Eight platform fluttered briskly. When Chen Ji entered the arena, surrounding disciples cast mocking or curious glances. He lowered his head, hunched his back, looking like a pushover waste, like a chick that had wandered into a flock of cranes. "Did that waste really make it to the Top Eight?" "Heh, probably got a good draw. The real tough battles haven't started yet." "Shh, the Fifth Elder has ordered, today's matchups seem to have been changed temporarily..." Whispered discussions buzzed like mosquitoes, Chen Ji ignored them all, his gaze sweeping across the audience—Su Qingyao was seated in the Inner Disciple section, her cold gaze briefly meeting his, as if carrying deep meaning.

dialogue.content: (Innersneered) The Fifth Elder's reach is long enough to temporarily alter the Top Eight matchups. So eager to see me dead?

text.content: Above the platform, the administrative elder cleared his throat, his voice thundering: "The Top Eight matchups have been slightly adjusted. The original Qingsong Sect disciple scheduled to face Chen Ji has withdrawn due to circumstances. He will be replaced by Xuanwu Sect's Han Lieyang, junior brother!" Before the words finished, the entire arena erupted in uproar. Han Lieyang—that was Han Lie's own younger brother, the second-ranked expert among Xuanwu Sect's younger generation, said to have reached late Foundation Building, Combat Power rivaling that of the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow! The crowd automatically parted, a young man in black劲装 strode forward, his imposing aura like a deep abyss, each step making the earth tremble slightly. He cast a sidelong glance at Chen Ji, a contemptuous arc curling his lips: "So you're the one? I thought I'd face some formidable opponent. Meeting this minnow at the Top Eight is truly boring."

choice.prompt: Han Lieyang's provocation drew bursts of laughter from surrounding disciples. The Fifth Elder on the presiding platform revealed a satisfied smile. Facing this naked humiliation and conspiracy, Chen Ji had to make a choice—

choices.description: Use their own methods against them, putting Han Lieyang on the spot publicly, using sharp tongue to make him realize he is the true fool.
choices.visible_cost: Reveal partial strength, attracting higher-level attention
choices.visible_reward: Shock the entire audience, Reputation +2, but may incur greater hostility
choices.risk_hint: Han Lieyang has deep backing, publicly humiliating him may lead to post-match retaliation

text.content: Chen Ji slowly raised his head, the turbid eyes flickering with a gleam of light. He spoke in a tone almost resembling pity: "Han Junior Brother, my brother had the same expression when he last fought me. Later, he lay in bed for three months before he could walk." At these words, the noisy Martial Arena instantly fell silent. Han Lieyang's face changed dramatically, spiritualspiritual energy surged around him like tides. The surrounding disciples looked at each other in bewilderment—this waste actually dared to publicly expose Han Lie's wound? Yet Chen Ji simply smiled faintly, that smile more irritating to Han Lieyang than any mockery: "Boring? I think it's quite interesting. After all—" he paused slightly, "the more boring the opponent, the more memorable when they fall."

choices.text: Endure and build strength, secretly strategize
choices.description: Disdain for the跳梁小丑, transform anger into cold killing intent, let the opponent understand true despair through actual combat in the match.
choices.visible_reward: Preserve trump cards, letting enemies fall into deeper traps while underestimating
choices.risk_hint: Han Lieyang may become more excessive, difficult to counter if he commits violence publicly

text.content: Chen Ji did not speak, merely slightly shifted his body, avoiding Han Lieyang's oppressive aura. He lowered his head, shoulders trembling slightly, looking as if scared out of his wits. "Heh, is this fear?" Han Lieyang sneered, "What a waste of my time." Waves of laughter came from surroundings, the Fifth Elder nodded with satisfaction. However, no one noticed that beneath Chen Ji's lowered eyelids, his gaze was cold as the Nine Yin Cold Pool. He silently calculated in his heart: Han Lieyang, late Foundation Building, Xuanwu Sect secret technique "Xuanwu Zhenhai Jue," excels in close combat and water-attribute spells. Weakness—impatient and quick to anger, right-side defense has a flaw. Wait for him to press forward in contempt, and that will be his defeat.

The horn sounded across the heavens, the first Top Eight battle officially began. Chen Ji and Han Lieyang stood facing each other, ten zhang apart. The referee elder floated in mid-air, his expression solemn: "Sparring is the priority, stop at the appropriate point. Begin!" Before the words finished, Han Lieyang had already surged forward, black spiritual power coalescing around him into a Xuanwu phantom, carrying a surging water momentum to crush Chen Ji. "Die!" he shouted, a water-blue sword already condensed in his palm, the blade's radiance leaving cracks in the air wherever it passed. Shouts of alarm rose from the observation stands—this move, ordinary Foundation Building middle-stage disciples couldn't possibly withstand!

Yet Chen Ji's body swayed, actually dodging sideways half a zhang at an incredible angle, barely evading the sword's edge. Han Lieyang's pupils contracted— he'd thought this strike would surely hit! "Just lucky!" he coldly snorted, sword momentum undeterred, seven consecutive strikes like a tempest storm, each strike carrying power enough to severely wound ordinary disciples. Chen Ji fought while retreating, his steps seemingly chaotic, yet each footfall precisely landed in the gaps of his attacks. Doubtful voices gradually arose in the audience: "This waste... why hasn't he fallen?" "His footwork... seems to have some skill?" Su Qingyao slightly narrowed her eyes, deep in thought.

dialogue.content: Han Lieyang's offensive paused, coldly smiling: "Turns out a waste who can only dodge! Face me head-on if you have the guts!" He formed seals with both hands, spiritual power frantically pouring into the Martial Arena platform beneath, "Since you want to dodge, I'll make it so you have nowhere to run—Xuanwu True Water, Prison!"

text.content: The Martial Arena platform suddenly illuminated with patterns, countless water-blue chains shot from the ground, instantly sealing off all of Chen Ji's escape routes. This was Xuanwu Sect's enemy-trapping secret technique—once bound, unless broken by absolute force, one could only be at another's mercy! Han Lieyang laughed triumphantly: "Run! Keep running!" He raised another sword, the tip aimed directly at Chen Ji's Brow Center, "I want to see how long you can keep dodging, you waste!" Chen Ji was bound by chains at four limbs, unable to move, water-blue spiritual power invaded his body along the chains, his meridians throbbing with bursts of pain. His expression slightly changed, fine sweat beaded on his forehead—the Heavenly Fate Chains lived up to their reputation indeed.

choice.prompt: The chains tightened relentlessly, spiritual power invaded his body, Chen Ji was cornered—but he sensed the limit of those Heavenly Fate Chains, seemingly still falling just short of completely binding him. This was the final chance—

choices.text: Forcefully break through by consuming Heavenly Fate Value
choices.description: Utilize the power of the Tianji Record, calculating the weakest point of the chains, exchanging Heavenly Fate Value for instantaneous eruption, catching Han Lieyang completely off guard.
choices.visible_reward: Break the Xuanwu Sect secret technique publicly, shocking the entire audience
choices.risk_hint: Exposing partial Tianji Record abilities, may attract notice from those with ulterior motives

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze hardened, the Tianji Record thunderously flipped open in his Mental Sea, the fragmented pages glowing brilliantly. His vision penetrated the layers of water, finding the nearly invisible crack in the chains—northeast direction, three cun deep, a gap in 0.3 breaths from now! Now! He fiercely bit his tongue, spewing a mouthful of essence blood, Heavenly Fate power exploded within him, transforming into a dazzling sword light that stabbed directly at that flaw. "Snap!" The chains shattered on cue, dissolving into scattered water vapor. Han Lieyang's pupils quivered in shock, "Impossible!" he howled, yet before he finished, Chen Ji had already closed in like a ghost, slapping his chest. With a dull thud, Han Lieyang flew backward, arcing through the air, crashing heavily three zhang away. The entire arena fell deathly silent.

choices.text: Pretend exhaustion, lure out forbidden techniques
choices.description: Continue feigning a boundtrash appearance, enticing Han Lieyang to use even more ruthless moves, preferably goading him into using forbidden techniques that backfire.
choices.visible_cost: Sustain more damage, body reaching its limit
choices.visible_reward: Make Han Lieyang commit foul play and be punished, killing two birds with one stone
choices.risk_hint: If Han Lieyang's forbidden technique power exceeds expectations, may suffer serious injury

text.content: Chen Ji's body softened, seemingly truly exhausted. Seeing this, Han Lieyang was overjoyed, thinking he'd won. He laughed as he approached: "What's the matter, waste is waste, can't even withstand this level of attack—" He raised his hand, preparing to deliver the final blow. Yet at this moment, Chen Ji's lips suddenly curved into a cold smile. "What?" Before Han Lieyang could react, Chen Ji somehow held a jade talisman—the thing he'd "accidentally" kicked earlier before the match. The talisman exploded, a golden light shot out, striking Han Lieyang's brow center! "You..." Han Lieyang's eyes rolled up, falling rigidly. The referee elder flew down, checked his breathing, his expression drastically changed: "He used a forbidden technique! 'Xuanwu Forbidden Killing Art'! This art is prohibited in sparring! Han Lieyang, foul—disqualified!"

Yet things did not end there. The fallen Han Lieyang suddenly let out a beast-like roar, his body's spiritual power狂暴涌出, the Xuanwu phantom expanded drastically, actually breaking free from the golden talisman's restraint in an instant! "Kill... kill him!" Han Lieyang's eyes were crimson red, his face contorted, where was there any trace of reason? This was unmistakably Xuanwu Sect's cruelest forbidden technique—'Xuanwu Forbidden Killing Art'! Burning one's own lifespan and foundation as the price, forcibly driving ten times the combat power, the cost being the practitioner would completely lose reason, becoming a monster that only knew slaughter! The Fifth Elder's expression slightly changed, yet he did not intervene, merely gazing meaningfully at the arena.

狂暴的 spiritual power swept across the arena, Han Lieyang's form swelled to one zhang, the Xuanwu phantom solidified into reality wrapping around him, hard iron-like scales covering his entire body. He threw a punch, the void trembled, the拳风 carried terrifying power enough to destroy mountains and split rocks, directly targeting Chen Ji's face. At this moment, even Su Qingyao couldn't help but stand up, her cold eyes showing rare worry. Yet at this critical moment, a hoarse yet authoritative voice suddenly rang out: "Enough." Just two simple words, yet like a great bell of the Dao, deafening everyone present. A illusory giant hand extended from the Void, lightly patting down, burying that berserk Han Lieyang three chi into the ground, utterly immobile.

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's form slowly materialized from the Void, gray robes fluttering, faint ink-colored radiance swirling around him. His gaze swept across the entire arena before landing on the Fifth Elder, his tone plain yet carrying undeniable authority: "A junior sparring match, why resort to forbidden techniques? Xuanwu Sect's reach truly grows longer." The Fifth Elder's face turned ashen, yet he dared not meet eyes with this legendary Residual Soul Guardian, could only force a smile: "Mo Xiansheng's instruction is wise. This逆徒擅自 used forbidden techniques, we will certainly punish severely..." Mo Xiansheng no longer looked at him, turning to Chen Ji, those deep eyes seeming to hold countless words, yet saying nothing. "Today's match concludes here."

text.content: The match was interrupted by the incident. Though Chen Ji won, the damage sustained was not minor. Supported by servant disciples, he left the Martial Arena, yet his mind was rapidly calculating. Why would Mo Xiansheng intervene at this moment? He had clearly said he would not appear unless faced with life and death. Could it be... he had been secretly watching over him? Night wind rose, Chen Ji returned to his quarters alone. As he pushed open the door, he saw a familiar figure standing with its back to him before the window. Mo Xiansheng! Chen Ji's heart jolted, instinctively gripping the talisman in his sleeve. Mo Xiansheng slowly turned around, his aged face appearing especially haggard under the candlelight. "Chen Ji, I have words for you." His voice was low, carrying a fatigue Chen Ji had never heard before.

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng was silent for a long while, the moonlight outside the window stretching his shadow long. Finally, he spoke, his voice hoarse as if awakened from a thousand-year slumber: "Chen Ji, do you know who your father is?" This question was like a thunderclap, exploding in Chen Ji's Mental Sea. He had never heard his mother mention his father, only knowing he had vanished before his birth, his life or death unknown. Mo Xiansheng seemed to have long anticipated his reaction, giving a tragic smile: "Your father... was once my best friend."

text.content: These words were like a key, opening the door to Chen Ji's memories sealed for many years. He remembered his mother's sorrow in her eyes whenever she mentioned his father during his childhood, remembered those deliberately avoided questions, remembered the莫名 familiar fluctuation when he awakened the Tianji Record... So it turned out, everything had been foreshadowed. Mo Xiansheng took out an ancient jade pendant from his sleeve. The pendant bore a blurred rune, matching the pattern on the Tianji Record's cover exactly. "This is your father's legacy item, something I've kept for over twenty years. Today, it should be returned to its rightful owner." He extended the jade pendant toward Chen Ji, the old man's turbid eyes actually glistening with tears, "Chen Ji, your destiny is far heavier than you can imagine. And what I can tell you... is still far from enough."
